html:
Greetings, Agents! 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

Heroes have gathered from across the multiverse to protect the Infinity Stones.
The theme of the February MARVEL Future Fight Update is the <Infinity Watch>!

 

Use the power of the Guardian of the Galaxy to stop the Super Villains 
who are trying to misuse the power of the Infinity Stones.
 
New Uniforms, Tier-3 advancement, Potential Transcendence, 
and new Artifacts have been added for Gamora, Drax, and Adam Warlock!
Challenge the new World Boss Legend: Infinity Ultron with the updated heroes!

 

Also, the Danger Room Beta Test, which many Agents have participated in, is now over.
Related contents have been modified so that our Agents can progress their missions.

 

Check out the details below to prepare for future battles.

 

 

▣ Three New Uniforms

 

New Uniforms have been added to Adam Warlock, Gamora, and Drax!
Check out the remarkable activities of the Guardians of the Galaxy.
* New Uniform Skills are based on Skill Level 6 stats.
* The three new uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <New Update Celebration Event!>. 
* The new Uniforms can still be purchased in the Uniform Room after the sale event has ended.

 

 

▣ Adam Warlock Tier-3 & Ultimate Skill

 

Adam Warlock has taken the role of the guardian of the universe to stop the misuse of the Infinity Stones.

Check out the ultimate power that Adam Warlock has achieved through Tier-3 Advancement.

 

 

 

▣ Gamora and Drax Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential

 

The most powerful warriors of the Universe will help protect the Infinity Stones!
Check out the outstanding battle techniques of Gamora and Drax
who have maximized their teamwork as members of the Guardian of the Galaxy. 

 

 

▣ Danger Room Beta Test Over

 

We want to thank all our Agents for their active participation in the Danger Room Beta Test.
The Danger Room Beta Test will be over after the February Update,
and related contents and challenges will be modified.

 

1. The rewards for the final season of Danger Room will be given.
Target Agents: Agents who have a record of playing the final season of Danger Room: Extreme
at least once before the update.
Rewards: The Danger Room Chest of the rank achieved
* The rewards will be distributed during the maintenance so please check your Inbox.

 

2. The <S.H.I.E.L.D.’s Special Support> product with Danger Room related effects will be improved.
Before: Additional rewards can be achieved at the Danger Room. (S.H.I.E.L.D.’s Support Chest)
After: The S.H.I.E.L.D.’s Support Chest will be distributed to the Inbox for 15 days when first logging in to the game.
* Agents who already have S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Special Support effects applied will have changed effect applied automatically after the update and can acquire the chest by logging in to the game after the update.
* The duration of the effect will not be changed.

 

 

[Danger Room Support Chest →  S.H.I.E.L.D.’s Support Chest Component Change]

Before: Gold, M’kraan Crystal, M’kraan Shard, Phoenix Feather 
After: Norn Stone of each type, Rank 1 Black Anti-Matter, Norn Stone of Chaos, M’kraan Crystal, M’kraan Shard, Phoenix Feather 


3. Dimension Mission Contribution Rewards are improved so that X-Genes and Biometrics can be acquired.
- The 8th step will be added to the Dimension Mission Contribution Rewards where X-Genes and Biometrics can be acquired through a Contribution Chest.
* The Dimension Mission contribution and points will remain without being changed after the update.
* Agents can proceed with the 8th step rewards after the update only when the 7th step rewards has not been received before the update.
(Agents who have reached the Repeating Rewards before the update will be able to access the 8th step the next reset.)

 

[Contribution Chest]
The Contribution Chest will be distributed according to the Agent’s Level, divided into sections from level 1 to 110. Different amount of X-Genes and Biometrics will be acquired depending on the chest.
The S.H.I.E.L.D.’s Special Support will increase the amount of X-Genes and Biometrics in the chest.  


4. Danger Room related challenges have been modified.
- The Danger Room participation, victory, and quest challenges have been deleted.
* The rewards and challenge points that have already been acquired will not be changed. Please be sure to receive the rewards for finished challenges before the update.
- The Danger Room victory mission for Daily, Alliance, World Boss, Heroic Quest, S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy, Epic Quest, and other challenges will be changed to Dispatch Mission, Giant Boss Raid, Story and others.
* The mission count will not be changed when the challenge is in progress, and acquired rewards will not be changed.

 

5. Danger Room has been removed from the Game Guide, event points, Alliance effects, content board, and others.
 

 

▣ New World Boss Legend: Infinity Ultron  

 

Ultron, upgraded with the Infinity Stones, has arrived!
Prepare for the threat of the new Super Villain inspired by Marvel Studios’ What If...? 
   
1. The new World Boss Legend: Infinity Ultron has been added.  
Agents can enter with a team of three, consisting of Tier-3 or Potential Transcendence heroes 
after clearing the challenges. (Tier-2 heroes can be set as the five Ally Characters)

- Infinity Ultron is much stronger than the existing World Boss Legends!
  Superior skills and proper preparation will be needed to face him!

 

2. Clear the new World Boss Legend: Infinity Ultron to receive various rewards.
- Search for Potential points, Tier-2 and 3 advance materials, C.T.P. Reforging Core, Conquer Level points, and others will be given.
* The acquisition of Cosmic Cube Fragments will also be guaranteed in the World Boss Legend: Infinity Ultron.
* The Mighty C.T.P. of Destruction can be acquired at a certain rate when clearing World Boss Legend: Infinity Ultron.
* The Special Icon <Ultron’s Victory> will be given as a First Clear Reward upon clearing difficulty 1.
* 4★ - 6★ Artifact - <Ultimate Lifeform>(Ultron) can be acquired upon clearing certain difficulties for the first time.
* The Biometrics: Ultron will not be given as a clear reward regardless of possession of the character.

 

3. The World Boss UI has been improved. 

4. New Challenges related to the new World Boss Legend: Infinity Ultron have been added.  

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

The Exclusive Passive Skill Artifact for Gamora, Drax, Adam Warlock, and Ultron will be added after the February Update. 

* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill LV.4 stats. 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will start after the update.
You can obtain various rewards along with Special Icons in the Future Pass!

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- The Future Pass will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Opened Legendary / Mythic Future Pass will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Mythic Pass can only be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Pass will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. Please check the sale period in the game.

 

New Special Icons have been added for our Agents!
Collect two new icons as Future Pass Rewards, 
one as World Boss rewards, and one more from the upcoming Event!


[February Update New Special Icons]

 

 

▣ Other Information

 

1. Improvements have been made so that the maximum option of Custom Gear can be checked in the Inventory, manage Custom Gear, Enhance, Change Option, and Reforge screen as well. 

 

2. The contents of the Reforge Guide that can be viewed by tapping the “?” icon when Reforging has been improved.  

 

3. The Save Team feature has been added for Alliance Conquest.
- Up to 10 team slots can be applied.
- Defeated heroes can be set as a team and one hero can be set for multiple teams. 
  However, when some heroes cannot be used because they have been defeated or are in defense, only the available heroes will be loaded. 

 

4. Improvements have been made to the selector item pop-ups.
- Item descriptions will be displayed.
- Option information on ISO-8, Comic Cards, C.T.P., Uru/Odin’s Blessing, and Artifact will be displayed.

 

5. Improvements have been made so that the Gear button will be displayed on the character’s Info tab after the completion of certain Epic Quests.

 

6. Improvements have been made so that the amount of Crystals in possession is displayed on the Guided Quest - Character Plus and Guided Quest - Special Plus pop-up screen.

 

7. Improvements have been made so that the list of teams can be scrolled by touching the empty slots when saving teams for the Giant Boss Raid.

 

8. Improvements have been made so that more achievement points can be earned through Dimension Rift.

 

9. Improvements have been made so that the information on the amount and type of item that you can acquire by Super Success in Craft can be checked out.

 

10. Improvements have been made so that tapping on the back button from the [Change Option] screen will bring you back to the Custom Gear Management screen instead of the Custom Gear tab on the character’s Info screen.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue of the 3rd active skill of Valkyrie <Fearless Defenders> not counterattacking when used to enemies with the Ignore Targeting effect has been fixed.
     
2. The issue of the Open / Acquire screen not showing up when the World Boss Invasion results have ended has been fixed.
 
3. The issue of an error code appearing when tapping the Combine button without selecting the materials when Combining ISO-8 has been fixed.
 
4. The issue of the Ignore Targeting and Guard Break icon being displayed wrongly in the skill tab of the hero information screen in some cases has been fixed.


5. The issue of the effect Charm ignoring a specific effect
- Ignored effect: HP does not drop to 1 or below. Recovers HP by N% of Max HP when the buff ends.

 

6. The issue of the hero list scroll information being reset instead of showing the current selected hero when using the back feature after viewing specific heroes in [Team] - [My Team].

 

7. The issue of certain Leader Skills and Passive Skills being partially removed from Incapacitation and Remove skill effects has been fixed.
(ex: Moleculeman’s Leader Skill ‘Material Transformation’ - Removes all Debuffs.)

 

8. The issue of acquiring Silver Trophies in Timeline Battle even though the requirements were not met in certain situations has been fixed.

 

We will return with more improvements, so please stay tuned.
 
Thank you.
